prompt:
A line-art multi-panel storyboard of one continuous scene of a live-action short drama: one image divided into a grid of 3 columns and 4 rows of equal 9:16 panels, 11 panels read from left to right and top to bottom; cells after the last panel stay plain white. Every panel is a colouring-book drawing: contours only, in one thin uniform black line on white, most of the panel left white. Draw only the people and the few large shapes of the place (walls, doors, windows, a bed, a car). People are simple storyboard figures: hair is one smooth outline of its shape, like a cap, empty inside, with no strands, curls or waves; a face has one short line each for the eyes, brows, nose and mouth, and no stubble, wrinkles or jaw lines; a fence is its posts and top rail, a tree its outline. No texture, mesh, bricks, leaves or fabric folds; no shading, grey or solid black: dark hair, clothes and cars are outlines left white inside. Thin black panel borders, plain white gutters. Location: Garden of the wedding venue, Day, bright sunny garden light.
Image 1: the character sheet of Cassie (23), look S1
Image 2: the character sheet of Sebastian (30), look S2
Image 3: the character sheet of Natalie (25), look S1
Image 4: the character sheet of Officiant (58)
Image 5: the character sheet of Guest 2 (25)
Image 6: the character sheet of Guest 1 (25)
Image 7: the character sheet of George (55), look S1
Image 8: the character sheet of Lauren (50), look S1
Image 9: the location Garden of the wedding venue, the front view, the establishing view, facing the back wall, with no people
Image 10: the location Garden of the wedding venue, the back view, turned 180 degrees, facing the front wall, with the left wall at its right edge, with no people
Image 11: the location Garden of the wedding venue, the left-side view, facing the left wall, with the back wall at its right edge, with no people
Image 12: the location Garden of the wedding venue, the right-side view, facing the right wall, with the back wall at its left edge, with no people
Image 13: the location Garden of the wedding venue, the floor plan seen from above: its top edge is the back wall, its bottom edge the front wall behind the front view's camera, and its left and right edges the left and right walls, with no people
Image 14: the blocking reference of this segment, the same place with its people in their places at the start; use it only for where each person is and which way they face, and keep each person on that seat or spot, on the same side of the room, in every panel until a shot moves them; do not copy its colours or light
Image 15: the prop wedding-gift box; use only structure, material, and color
Image 16: the prop glasses of champagne; use only structure, material, and color
Draw each character so they can be told apart as in their reference image, by the shape of the hairstyle, the build and the outfit in outline only; never copy the photograph's detail. Use the character sheets only for the characters, not for their layout, white background or multiple views. Use the location images only for the layout of the space and the place of its furniture and props, drawn in outline. There is only one of each vehicle, piece of furniture and prop that the location shows, defined by the location images, throughout all panels; when a panel shows only part of one, such as a car's hood, it is that same object, and no second one appears. Each panel shows only the characters it names, and nobody appears twice in one panel.
At the start: Natalie and Sebastian stand close together, face to face, under the centre of the wedding arch, Natalie's hands lowering from his lapels, Sebastian on the boxwood-hedge side. George stands beside Natalie under the arch on the rose-bush side, holding the bouquet. The Officiant stands just behind the couple at the centre of the arch, facing down the aisle. Cassie stands at the head of the aisle a step in front of Natalie on the rose-bush side, holding the empty gift box. Lauren stands at the head of the aisle against the front-row chair on the boxwood-hedge side, her handbag on her arm. Natalie's phone lies face up on the seat of the front-row chair on the rose-bush side. Guest 1 (arch side) and Guest 2 (aisle side) stand at the one small round white high cocktail table on the boxwood-hedge side, each holding a champagne flute, Guest 1's phone in the clutch under her arm.
Panel 1: Medium shot, handheld camera following Cassie from in front of Natalie to Sebastian's side, eye-level, from the rose-bush side of the aisle. Cassie steps past the front of Natalie to Sebastian's hedge side under the arch and reaches for his arm with a seductive smile, the empty gift box in her other hand; Natalie and the Officiant stand behind them.
Panel 2: Medium shot, three-shot, locked-off camera, eye-level. Sebastian steps back out of Cassie's reach to Natalie's side and glances at Natalie; Cassie's hand closes on air and she backs off toward Lauren at the front-row chair on the hedge side.
Panel 3: Medium shot, locked-off camera, eye-level. At the cocktail table by the hedge, Guest 2 laughs into her champagne glass while Guest 1 beside her, flute in hand, covers a grin.
Panel 4: Close-up, clean single on her face, locked-off camera, eye-level. Cassie's smile drops; she flushes and glares toward the cocktail table, her fingers tightening on the gift box.
Panel 5: Medium shot, locked-off camera, eye-level, Sebastian's shoulder at one frame edge and George's arm at the other. Natalie, under the arch, turns toward Lauren at the front-row chair on the hedge side and holds out her palm; George beside her grips the bouquet.
Panel 6: Close-up insert, locked-off camera, eye-level. Lauren's hands clutch her small handbag tight against her hip, her diamond ring flashing.
Panel 7: Medium shot, locked-off camera, eye-level, from the rose-bush side of the aisle, Cassie's shoulder at the frame edge. Lauren, against the front-row chair on the hedge side with Cassie now beside her, lifts her chin with a thin, dismissive smile.
Panel 8: Medium shot, slight low angle, slow push in on Sebastian, eye-line toward the head of the aisle. Sebastian steps up beside Natalie, still on her boxwood-hedge side, and fixes his eyes on Lauren.
Panel 9: Medium shot, locked-off camera, eye-level, Lauren's shoulder at the frame edge. Cassie, beside Lauren at the front-row chair, folds her arms over the gift box and tilts her head with a sneer.
Panel 10: Medium close-up, clean single, locked-off camera, eye-level. Sebastian smiles lazily, his steel-grey eyes moving from Cassie to Lauren.
Panel 11: Medium shot, locked-off camera, eye-level, from the rose-bush side of the aisle. Lauren's jaw tightens against the front-row chair, and Cassie beside her shoots a glare toward the arch.
Keep the characters, the number and position of every vehicle, piece of furniture and prop, and the location's spatial orientation consistent across all panels.
No text, letters, numbers, captions, speech bubbles, panel labels or watermark anywhere in the image; no photographic rendering.
